offer.name: Leion Delivery Founding Pilot
offer.audience: Agencies and software factories with repeated GitHub delivery work.
offer.problem: Repeated GitHub delivery work stays manual, opaque, and hard to govern.
offer.promise: Turn issue-to-PR, PR fix, and release gates into governed AI workflows with explicit human approval.
offer.proof: Show 3 delivery flows running on one repo with traceable approvals and reusable run history.
offer.callToAction: Book a 30-minute pilot scoping call on one target repository.

funnel.acquisition: Founder outbound to 100 qualified agencies and software factories.
funnel.qualification: Confirm repeated GitHub delivery pain, approval needs, and a repo suitable for a pilot.
funnel.demo: Run the 3 delivery workflows live on a target repo or a realistic demo repo.
funnel.proposal: Offer a fixed-fee founding pilot with one org, five repos max, and three workflows.
funnel.close: Convert the pilot into monthly governance and control-plane subscription.

templates.name: Founder outbound email
templates.subject: Governed AI delivery workflows for your GitHub flow
templates.body:
Bonjour {{name}},

je travaille sur Leion Delivery: un cockpit de workflows IA gouvernes pour equipes software.

L idee n est pas de laisser un agent coder seul. L idee est de transformer des etapes repetitives comme Issue -> PR, PR review/fix et release gate en flows tracables avec validation humaine.

Si vous avez ce type de friction dans GitHub, je peux te montrer un pilote tres concret sur un repo cible.

Matth

templates.name: LinkedIn follow-up
templates.body:
Bonjour {{name}},
je reviens vers toi au sujet de Leion Delivery.
On aide les equipes a standardiser issue -> PR, PR fix et release gate avec validation humaine explicite.
Si tu veux, je peux te montrer le flow sur un repo de demo.

mcpServers.name: GitHub MCP
mcpServers.notes:
Reference MCP surface already visible in local logs.

Connected and listed MCP tools.

providerAccounts.label: Gmail
providerAccounts.notes:
[Gmail OAuth]
Flow: desktop OAuth with loopback callback and PKCE.
Scopes: OpenID, Gmail drafts and send, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file.
Mode: draft-first and manual-first. No blind auto-send.

providerAccounts.label: Google Workspace
providerAccounts.notes:
[Google OAuth]
Flow: desktop OAuth with loopback callback and PKCE.
Scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.profile, https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email, OpenID, Google Drive (file-level), Google Sheets.
Surface: Google Sheets and Drive first. Gmail comes next as a separate connector.
